We are looking for a skilled Python Developer with experience in designing, developing, and maintaining applications that leverage Business Rules Engines (BRE). The ideal candidate will have strong Python development skills, a good understanding of business rule management, and experience translating complex business requirements into configurable and maintainable rules.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using Python.
Develop and implement business rules and decision logic using Business Rules Engine frameworks/platforms.
Translate business requirements and functional specifications into technical solutions and executable rules.
Design rule models, decision logic, rule flows, and rule validation mechanisms.
Integrate BRE solutions with Python applications, APIs, databases, and other enterprise systems.

Optimize business rules and application logic for performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Business rules and decision logic
Rule authoring and management
Rule execution and evaluation
Rule versioning and lifecycle management
Decision tables / rule tables
Rule prioritization and conflict resolution
Experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle.
Experience with Git and standard software development practices.
Good understanding of unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

Job description

Key Responsibilities

Data Collection & Management

Collect, organize, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources
Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across systems
Maintain structured datasets for academic, HR, finance, and operational reporting
Perform regular data quality checks and cleansing activities

Data Analysis

Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and insights
Prepare periodic reports on KPIs, performance metrics, and business outcomes
Conduct comparative and predictive analysis for strategic decision-making
Support management with actionable recommendations based on findings

Dashboard & Reporting

Design and maintain dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or Excel
Create daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly MIS reports
Automate recurring reporting workflows
Develop visual reports for leadership presentations

Business Intelligence Support

Support strategic teams in forecasting, capacity planning, and performance reviews
Analyze student, employee, financial, and process-related data
Provide insights for operational optimization and growth initiatives
Assist in identifying process bottlenecks through data trends

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with academic, HR, finance, and operations teams
Understand business requirements and translate them into analytical reports
Support leadership with data-backed decision frameworks



Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or related field
Proven experience as a Data Analyst, MIS Analyst, or Business Analyst
Strong command of MS Excel (Advanced)
Working knowledge of SQL
Experience with Power BI / Tableau
Good understanding of statistics and data interpretation
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
Excellent attention to detail
Strong verbal and written communication skills



Preferred Technical Skills

SQL queries and database handling
Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib)
Excel automation and advanced formulas
Pivot tables, Power Query, dashboards
Data visualization and storytelling
Forecasting and trend analysis
KPI framework creation



Key Competencies

Analytical mindset
Business acumen
Accuracy and precision
Time management
Stakeholder communication
Reporting excellence
Insight generation



Performance Metrics

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

reporting accuracy
turnaround time
dashboard effectiveness
insight quality
automation efficiency
business impact of recommendations



Career Growth

This role offers progression opportunities into:

Senior Data Analyst
Business Intelligence Analyst
Strategy Analyst
Analytics Lead
